summary: Admit the bounded Деловые Линии pickup-cancellation variant through the reviewed runtime.

impacts.evidence: The existing authenticated cancellation route and outbox event retain the tenant scope before the worker invokes the connector.
The added variant is a two-value enum; provider requests contain no additional PII and raw responses remain inside transport.
The cancel endpoint gains an optional body with a bounded delivery/pickup variant while empty body remains backward compatible.
The shipment-changed event schema gains an optional cancel_variant enum used only for cancel_requested operations.
The neutral ShipmentCancelRequest gains an optional variant and generated API SDKs accept the optional request body.
The variant is carried by the existing operation event and digest; no schema or persistent provider field changes.
The worker validates the enum before connector invocation, uses callback-scoped credentials and fixed HTTPS endpoints, and never forwards raw provider data.
Both variants reuse the existing approval-bound shipment cancellation action and write-sensitive risk class.
The existing cancellation request audit remains authoritative and the event carries the exact bounded mode used for execution.
The cancellation digest binds the selected variant and ambiguous carrier responses remain pending/unknown without blind retry.
Dellin pickup cancellation adds one fixed official HTTPS endpoint and no inbound webhook surface.
Shared HTTP timeout, response validation and normalized pending/error results cover both cancellation endpoints.
Removing the pickup branch or enum closes only the new variant while the delivery default remains available.
Transport and worker fixtures verify endpoint selection, request identity, event propagation and rejection of invalid variants.
